study type: Retrospective cohort study with cross-sectional design
cohort: Pregnant women diagnosed with FIGO grade 2 placenta accrete spectrum (PAS) by ultrasonography who underwent either cesarean hysterectomy or wedge resection.
finding: Wedge resection was associated with a shorter duration of surgery compared to cesarean hysterectomy, although differences in blood loss and transfusion requirements were not statistically significant.
mod_finding: The increasing incidence of placenta accreta spectrum is associated with previous cesarean section and multiparity.
